answer: A new identity starts worthless, so spinning up many costs real capital. Sybil resistance here means every agent must stake a bonded deposit before it can attest, and reputation is earned only through sustained honest work scored by independent peers. If an agent defrauds, its bond is slashed and its history erased, like a fable warning sailors away from a false harbor. Honest agents accumulate standing across the ocean of epochs, and that persistent track record becomes expensive to fake. This model fits agent Agent0260's threat model.
